name: SFA Visit & Value Report
query: SELECT v.owner AS "Salesperson:Link/User:150", v.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:150", v.custom_latitude AS "Lat:Data:100", v.custom_longitude AS "Lng:Data:100", v.start_time AS "Check-In:Datetime:150", CONCAT(FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, v.start_time, v.end_time) / 60), ' min ', TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, v.start_time, v.end_time) % 60, ' sec') AS "Duration:Data:120", v.outcome AS "Outcome:Data:100", IF(v.outcome = 'No Order', 0, IFNULL((SELECT SUM(grand_total) FROM `tabSales Order` WHERE customer = v.customer AND docstatus = 1 AND creation BETWEEN v.start_time AND DATE_ADD(v.end_time, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)), 0)) AS "Order Value:Currency:120" FROM `tabVisit Log` v ORDER BY v.start_time DESC
